title.narrative: To improve multisector cooperation in preventing, and responding to online abuse of children in Ukraineey (PES), prepared ive)

description.narrative: a) The situational analysis regarding online child abuse towards and among children in Ukraine has been carried out; b) The international toolkit and practices on cyber bullying have been adapted to address violence against young women and girls within the Ukrainian context.c) The preventive programs have been developed and piloted for various age groups of children to be applied by law enforcement professionals. d) The modern standards in initial and inservice training of law enforcement professionals to address online abuse among and towards children have been adapted and shared.e) The programs of initial and inservice training for law enforcement professionals together with Universities of Infernal Affairs in three pilot regions have been implemented.f) The elearning courses on prevention and on responses to online child abuse for law enforcement agencies with Universities of Infernal Affairs have been developed and piloted in three pilot regions.
